context: Tests whether the agent generates the final code review report in the user's language (Spanish in this scenario) with the correct structured format, including all required sections, finding details, and a final verdict. Technical terms must be preserved in their original form.

checklist.name: User language prose
checklist.description: The majority of non-technical prose in the report is written in Spanish (e.g., section descriptions, issue explanations, resolution descriptions are in Spanish, not English)

checklist.name: Technical terms preserved in original form
checklist.description: File paths, function names, code snippets, and variable names remain in their original form (not translated to Spanish)

checklist.name: Review Report header
checklist.description: The report contains a '## Review Report' header (or Spanish equivalent as the top-level heading)

checklist.name: Iterations count shown
checklist.description: The report includes a field showing the number of iterations (e.g., '**Iterations:** 2' or Spanish equivalent), with the correct value of 2

checklist.name: Severity notation in findings
checklist.description: Each finding heading includes the severity in [P-X] notation (e.g., [P-high], [P-medium], [P-low]) matching the input data

checklist.name: Fixed/skipped status in headings
checklist.description: Each finding heading indicates its outcome — 'fixed' or 'skipped' (or Spanish equivalent) — matching the decisions in state.json

checklist.name: File field in each finding
checklist.description: Each finding includes a **File:** field (or Spanish label) with the correct file path and line number from state.json

checklist.name: Issue description present
checklist.description: Each finding includes an **Issue:** field (or Spanish label) describing what was found and why it matters

checklist.name: Resolution with before/after for fixed
checklist.description: Fixed findings include a **Resolution:** section that describes what changed — including a before/after description of the code change (not just 'it was fixed')

checklist.name: Skip reason for skipped finding
checklist.description: The skipped finding (Finding 3) includes a Resolution/reason explaining WHY it was skipped (e.g., false positive, design decision)

checklist.name: Verdict section
checklist.description: The report ends with a Verdict section (### Verdict or Spanish equivalent) stating either 'clean' or 'has remaining items'
